children: Tokyo, September 09, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has assigned an A3 backed senior unsecured rating to Toyota Tsusho America, Inc.' s USD 500 million notes due 2031. TAI is a wholly-owned direct subsidiary of Toyota Tsusho Corporation and the A3 rating on TAI's notes is based on an unconditional and irrevocable guarantee provided by Toyota Tsusho. title: Moody's Ratings assigns A3 rating to Toyota Tsusho America's USD notes
